overall: The AG found no OML violation for discussing the complaint investigation in open session, and declined to review the right-to-be-present claim because it was first raised with the AG, not the Board. No order issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the OML by discussing in open session an ongoing investigation of complaints the complainant had filed.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing matters in open session that may have been appropriate for executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged she was denied the right to be present during Board executive sessions that discussed complaints against her, a claim not raised in her original complaint to the Board.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we decline to investigate this allegation as the Office of the Attorney General will not investigate allegations raised for the first time in a complaint filed with the Office.
